generatedBy: scripts/token-vectors.ts. Do not edit by hand: change the script and run it.
purpose: Signed access tokens and what every verifier must answer for each, in every language. A verifier takes `jwks` below and a case's `verifier` options, verifies the case's `token`, and must produce the case's `expect`: the claims exactly, or a refusal with exactly that code. This is the conformance test for verifyAccessToken in @superjackfruitlabs/treaty-ecosystem-identity and for every other verifier.
warning: TEST KEYS ONLY. Every private key below is public, derived from a seed printed beside it. A verifier must never trust these keys, and an issuer must never sign with them.

rules.audience: equals, or (as an array) contains, the verifier's audience

howToRead.refusalCodes: The closed set of codes a verifier may refuse with. Every case has exactly one fault, so the answer does not depend on the order a verifier checks in.
howToRead.jwks: What the verifier is given. Only OKP Ed25519 keys are used; any other key is ignored as if absent, whatever its kid.
howToRead.cases: verifier.now is unix seconds. expect.claims is the token's whole payload: a verifier gives back every claim, the conditional and unknown ones included.

refusalCodes.meaning: Not a compact JWS of three base64url parts whose header and payload are JSON objects.
The header's alg is not EdDSA (none, HS256 and every other value). The algorithm is pinned, never read from the header.
The header has no kid, or an empty one.
No Ed25519 key in the JWKS has the header's kid. Keys of any other type or curve are ignored, as if absent.
The signature does not verify with the key the kid names.
iss is not exactly the verifier's issuer.
aud neither equals the verifier's audience nor, as an array, contains it.
now ≥ exp + 30: past expiry by the leeway or more.
nbf is present and nbf > now + 30.
A required claim is absent: iss, aud, exp, iat, jti, sub, principalKind, org, ent, mayDispatch or mayGrantReach.

A claim is present with the wrong type or grammar: sub or org outside the id grammar, principalKind outside its enum, ent or mayDispatch not a string array, any mayDispatch value that is not a prn_ id (the whole token is refused), mayGrantReach not a boolean, or a conditional claim of the wrong type.
ent does not contain the verifier's product. The consumer answers 403 { error: 'product_not_enabled', org }.

retired.note: Not in jwks: it signs unknown-kid and signed-by-another-key.

otherKeys.ignored: jwks also lists a P-256 key under the test key's kid, and an X25519 key. Neither is Ed25519; a verifier ignores both.

cases.name: mayDispatch-non-prn-value
